entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I'm a bit overwhelmed. I ordered this jersey and it's not right, and I tried to figure out the website but I'm just so confused.
I can certainly help you with that, no problem at all. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference, I suppose? It's the wrong size for me. The jersey is just way too tight across the shoulders. I think I need to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure out how. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I can definitely walk you through this. Let me just pull up your account. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, yes, I have it here. It's VF-774-9012.
Perfect, thank you. I see the order for the ClubFit Jersey, delivered nine days ago. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day window for a return.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can send it back then?

Absolutely. I've just started the process for you. I can email you a prepaid return label right now. You can just print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off. We can process a full refund, or if you prefer, we can handle the exchange for the next size up.
An exchange for a larger size would be perfect! Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so simple.
You are very welcome. I've noted the exchange in your file. As soon as we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the new one. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that was it. I really appreciate your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
